summary.intent: Fix the npm manifest updater in callisto-manifests so that npm overrides/resolutions entries that reference another dependency (e.g. `$pkg`) or redirect it (e.g. protocol specs like `npm:`) are not rewritten as plain version ranges.
summary.outcome: Updated npm.rs and its tests via a script, formatted, and ran the lib tests. A mutation check broke and restored the fix to confirm the new `leaves_reference_and_protocol` test catches the regression, then the change was committed. Test pass/fail results were not visible in the transcript.

repo: Unit tests for the npm manifest logic live in crates/callisto-manifests/src/npm/tests.rs, a sibling file to npm.rs.
Tests are run per crate with `cargo test -p callisto-manifests --lib`, and a test name filter such as `leaves_reference_and_protocol` can narrow the run.
The repo uses `cargo fmt` as part of the edit-test loop, and commit messages follow conventional-commit style, e.g. `fix(manifests): ...`.

code.finding: Existing tests around this range cover update_dependency_spec behavior and were inspected as a template for the overrides/resolutions tests.
This range holds related overrides/resolutions tests that were inspected before adding the new cases.

workflow: Edits were applied by writing a throwaway Python script outside the repo and running it with `python3 -I`, rather than editing files in place.
A mutation check (script with `break` and `restore` modes) was used to prove the new test fails when the fix is reverted, and the fix was then restored and the full suite re-run.
Git was invoked via /usr/bin/git with `add -A` and a quiet commit chained in the same command as the final test run, so the commit happened regardless of the test outcome.

friction: The final command chained the restore, full test run and commit with `;`, so a failing suite would not have stopped the commit.
Test output was truncated with `tail -1`/`tail -3`, which hides failure detail.
open_items: Confirm the full callisto-manifests suite passed after restoring the fix, since the output was not shown.
Check that `git add -A` did not stage unrelated files in the commit.
